newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Eagle sees A$10 mln 1st half profit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Eagle sees A$10 mln 1st half profit.

text.p: Eagle Mining NL said on Monday it was on target to achieve a net profit of A$10 million for the six months to December 31 this year.
The company said the positive first half result followed a A$7.0 million net profit in 1995/96 ended June 30.
It did not provide further details in a statement issued at the annual meeting of shareholders in Perth.
The company's Nimari mine in Western Australia contains an estimated 940,000 ounces of gold and the stock has recently been recommended by leading brokerage firm J.B. Were and Son.
Eagle acquired Nimary's minority owner Matlock Mining NL in a share swap dealer earlier this year.
